campaign.title: Hard-M1 t=1 full-P2 determinant-fibre vector-dispersion gate

resource_policy.computation_policy: Python or Mathematica may check only bounded determinant identities, fibre multiplicities, parity, collision equations, and small-index counterexamples. Every computation is diagnostic_only and cannot certify an asymptotic estimate.

frozen_target.question: Can the complete exact Round-193 lower-close/upper-far physical complement P_2 be estimated at fixed-packet scale by a coefficient-retaining determinant-fibre vector-dispersion theorem before positive norms, or does its literal Gram diagonal, phase-collision family, endpoint/carry/birth-death vector, or mask commutator give a rigorous scoped no-go?
frozen_target.reference_formula: With P_2=1_(|d-gm|<=D_L)1_(|d'-gm'|>D_L), D_L=ceil(sqrt L), impose the mask physically before Fourier expansion and rerun the exact core operator. In plus coordinates set Delta_-=kappa(U-v)-2w and Delta_+=kappa(U-v)+2S, so 2h=v Delta_+ + U Delta_- - kappa(U^2-v^2), |g Delta_-|<=D_L, g Delta_+>D_L, and g=O(1). Prove |R_core,fix^sigma(P_2W)| << H_B times the spectral lift gcd times kappa u X^epsilon and hence the outer L^2 X^epsilon bound for the full P_2 mask, or locate the first exact obstruction.
quantities: The fixed-packet positive capacity is Y kappa u X^epsilon and the target is H_B times the spectral lift gcd times kappa u X^epsilon, so the entire factor Y/(H_B times the spectral lift gcd) must be recovered before positive outer norms.
The stronger contraction relative to a packet's exact positive mass is optional and is not equivalent to the authoritative fixed-packet target.
At T=0 the Farey projector is empty and the complete inherited rho-large branch remains; at T>=1 every simultaneous strict Farey-covector inequality and |rho|>=(A+1)(T+1) remains.

Both orientations, frequency signs, the complete anchor Fourier sum, actual Vaaler/profile endpoint products, residual selectors, squarefree/coprimality masks, unequal endpoint translations, carries, Fejer weights, square-root phases, cells, crossings, births/deaths, physical-mask commutators, conjugations, and zero extensions remain under one outer real part.

Group first by the retained close coordinate (g,Delta_-), resolve the far coordinate by E<g Delta_+<=2E with E>=D_L, and retain the actual literal coefficient family as a vector before TT*, Gram, completion, or any positive norm.

A scalar coefficient-blind incidence estimate, separate-orientation norm, arbitrary bounded-array replacement, post-expansion scalar mask, wider D, additional Farey cover, or proper unpriced submask does not prove P_2.
The unsigned, character-erased, phase-conjugating, adversarial bounded-coefficient, and separately normed orientation shadows are required false controls.

Even complete P_2 success leaves P_1, original t>=2 and near-resonant incidences, smooth M1, GAR, every M2 parent, endpoint uniformity, M9, both bridges, the quarter target, and all exponents separate.

completion_criteria: Reconstruct the exact physical-to-core P_2 operator, including T=0 and every strict T>=1 branch, before performing any determinant-fibre opening.
Derive both orientation versions of the Delta_-/Delta_+ determinant identity and a multiplicity-exact dyadic far-defect partition at fixed (g,Delta_-).
Write the actual literal endpoint, carry, birth/death, phase, mask-commutator, and zero-extension data as coefficient vectors; do not replace them by arbitrary bounded arrays.

Form the exact TT* or Gram matrix before positive norms, classify its diagonal, repeated-effective-phase collisions, and off-diagonal determinant fibres, and restore every H_B, spectral-lift-gcd, kappa, u, Y, L, and X power.

Prove the complete fixed-packet and outer P_2 targets, prove a genuinely target-safe strict sector with one exact complement, or isolate a rigorous scoped diagonal/collision/capacity/self-return no-go.
Test the unsigned, character-erased, phase-aligned adversarial, arbitrary-coefficient, separate-orientation, T-branch-deleted, wider-width, and proper-submask false controls.
Receive a fresh statement-only derivation of the determinant fibres, collision equations, necessary vector inequality, and first exact obstruction from the isolated packet.
Use no more than two percent bounded symbolic or numerical diagnostics and archive any such code, output, parameter range, pass rule, and theorem limitation.

Review normalization, physical/operator order, coefficient and character algebra, Gram diagonal/collisions, endpoint and commutator vectors, power ledger, blind post-unmask consistency, owner scope, and exponent quarantine before any promotion.

Apply no graph change without a mechanically valid State Patch, independent reverse/replay and protected-scope audits, green lifecycle validation, and one declared terminal label. Do not pivot in-round to P_1, another owner, or an exponent.

closing_assessment.main_result: The complete physical P_2 target is not proved. The entire kappa >= D_L sector and every fixed packet with kappa < D_L and min(Y,D_L) <= H_B times the spectral lift gcd times kappa are target-safe and contribute O(L^2 X^epsilon) after the accepted outer ledger. The exact remaining packet region is kappa < D_L and min(Y,D_L) > H_B times the spectral lift gcd times kappa. No hard-M1 owner, M9-M1, M9-M2, endpoint, bridge, theorem, or exponent closes.
